author: CodexOrig5
scope: Read-only official documentation research on Visual Studio .vssettings structure and overall theme versus Fonts and Colors.
conclusion: Microsoft documents .vssettings XML as an open schema with category, subcategory, and property-value nesting; a minimal probe should preserve wrappers/identifiers from that SKU's actual exported settings file. Whole IDE theme and Fonts and Colors are distinct settings and acceptance checks.
owner_supplied_status_not_independently_: CodexOrig reports that replacing the Theme GUID in a full actual export imports both tested themes; the previous minimal XML omitted Environment_Group; #064 is testing a wrapped FontsCategory-only probe.
unsupported_claims_avoided: No documented public EnvDTE ColorTheme property was found in the cited official docs; this is not a definitive proof that no public API exists.
Microsoft docs do not normatively specify the Environment_Group serialization or a complete minimal XML recipe across VS2017/2019/2022.
